_comment: OpenCode Go gateway. One API key reaches three wires; the gateway publishes each Model's wire, so rules route the Messages and Responses Models and every other Model speaks Chat Completions. Every wire carries the x-opencode-session prompt-cache affinity header (Adapter code). Chat replays readable reasoning_content only (OpenCode's own client never replays reasoning_details) and gives every historical Tool Call a reasoning_content carrier, empty when the call had no readable Reasoning: DeepSeek's thinking mode rejects a Tool Call without it. Responses is stateless (store false), takes only max_output_tokens (max_tokens maps onto it) and top_p, and structured output on every Model; its default ladder has no none rung because the gateway rejected an explicit none (live 2026-08-25), so only a Model whose ladder lists none sends it. Models that cannot stop reasoning get their cheapest rung for none. Replay scope is full_history for every Model, also where an upstream preserved-thinking contract is stronger than a particular gateway measurement. GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools outside the request's Tool list, so Tools announced mid-Session are listed there.

rules.note: The gateway serves MiniMax and Qwen Models on Anthropic Messages (/messages).
The gateway serves GPT, Grok and Muse Spark Models on stateless Responses (/responses); Grok 4.7 live low-effort smoke verified.
Hy and Kimi answer with readable reasoning plus reasoning_details; their history still replays reasoning_content.
These Models answer with readable reasoning_content; the listing carries no response-field hint for them.
DeepSeek's thinking switch is independent of its effort ladder: thinking stays enabled by default and with an effort; none disables it and sends no effort.
Binary thinking.type switch, enabled by default (MiMo V2.6 verified 2026-09-22).
Kimi K2.6 switches thinking on or off and keeps every earlier thinking turn (keep all) while enabled.
Kimi K2.7 Code always thinks: the request always enables thinking and sends no effort.
These Models always reason; none asks for the cheapest rung (low) instead of the higher default.
GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools that are not in the request's Tool list.
